status: Constructed conditional partial-health portfolio; independently reviewed; not measured expected value or verified marginal offer
organization: YMCA of Greater San Francisco / Young Men’s Christian Association of San Francisco

budget.allocationBasis: Judgment; historical broad categories inform service scope, NOT observed marginal weights

geography.meaning: SFshare .65/.75/.4 is unverified residence allocation prior for each quantifiable component; remainder Marin/SanMateo/other Bay participants. BayincludesSF, samegift. No inference from location.

costPerspective.donor: The entire $100,000 gift remains spent in every scenario. Offered-course allowances include noncompletion and allocated shared costs, but are judgments, not provider quotes.
costPerspective.resourceStress: The additional $100,000 field is a hypothetical extra-resource stress, not measured net societal cost or a claim those resources arise in the no-additionality case. Null scenarios retain no positive ratio regardless of this unpriced assumption.
costPerspective.unpriced: Public reimbursements, displaced payments, volunteer and participant time, travel and downstream resource savings are not reconciled. Do not label donor cash or the stress a comprehensive resource CEA.

causalDefinitions.additionality: Share of funded provision that changes access relative to no-gift public, private and household financing. Not course completion.
causalDefinitions.response: Incremental response conditional on changed provision versus usual care, including noncompletion. No second adherence factor.
causalDefinitions.geographicPrior: Assumes all quantified beneficiaries are Bay residents; SF fraction is unverified. Exclude or separately allocate any non-Bay benefit before claiming local health.
causalDefinitions.familyOverlap: Remove family credit if short hardship-related health cannot be distinguished from mental-health therapy or partner-food benefits already credited. Shared people can have genuinely distinct health gains.

duration.fitness: 16-week offered coached activity access, source QALY AUC months6–12 only, no later tail; transfer already incorporates response and weaker fidelity.
duration.mental: Bounded course over firstyear; integrated exposure.5/1/.1years by scenario includes response timing and decay, not lifetime remission.
duration.family: Short family hardship-support course; integrated health exposure.25/.5/.1year; not ongoing housing health.
duration.dpp: One-year course; three-year incident-risk contrast; prevented cases conservatively placed at endyear3, then utility relief in endyears3 through3+delay−1, discounted3%; delay2/5/1years. No lifelong diabetes avoidance.

formula.offeredCourses: allocation/courseCost; fractional offers are expectation accounting not purchasable fractions
formula.portfolio: sum(componentBayQ); SF=grossBay*sfShare−donorSFharm; restBay=grossBay*(1−share)−donorRestharm; Bay=SF+restBay; ratio10*100K/Q onlyifQpositive

boundaries: All local response, incidence, risk-reduction, utility, delay, cost and funding priors are judgments except external NERS .027 anchor.
Net conditional utility priors already include shared burdens; donor-specific harms outside funding. Core0notproofnoharm.
No DPP exercise benefit added again through fitness; distinguish overlapping health states, not all shared people.
Family credit limited short health-related hardship response, excludes separately counted therapy and food-bank outcomes.

Fitness generic EQ5D includes mental health. Central and stress allocations assume distinct fitness versus therapy health increments: separate cohorts, or remove therapy-related distress improvement already captured by fitness for the same person and period. Do not add full generic utilities for overlapping care; this cohort separation is a judgment, not verified local linkage.
30K youth/aquatics/campcapital cost remains while health unquantified; these streams have welfare and possible harm, not assumed valueless.
No current marginal weight, clinic-course quote, capacity or live donoroffer verified.
Donor prices are full-course resource allowances, not just copays. Publicfunding replacement is modeled viaadditionality. Grosscashspend not netsocietalresources.
Do not add allBaytoSF or use DPPalone as wholeorganization estimate.
